title: Bronze Rewards Card: How to Apply and Get Started
summary: Explains Bronze Rewards Card eligibility and application steps: minimum credit score $640 (consent to credit pull), annual fee $0.00, intro APR 0% for the first year, standard APR 20.49%, and minimum starting limit at least $3,000. Covers foreign transaction fee 2.75%, activation in the first 10 minutes, and that virtual card management is not available.
